title: Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station
description: Find the minimum possible value of the maximum distance between adjacent gas stations after adding k stations.
pseudocode:
1. low = 0, high = stations[n-1] - stations[0]
2. while high - low > 1e-6:
3.   mid = (low + high) / 2
4.   count = 0
5.   for i = 0 to n-2:
6.     count += floor((stations[i+1] - stations[i]) / mid)
7.   if count <= k: high = mid
8.   else: low = mid

steps.note: Initialize binary search range. Stations: [0, 10], k=1.
Check if adding stations at mid=5.0 fits k=1. (10-0)/5 - 1 = 1.
Count <= k is true, narrow search space to [0, 5].
